newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: McCollam to buy Format Publishers' assets.
newsitem.headline: McCollam to buy Format Publishers' assets.

text.p: McCollam Printers said on Monday the company had reached an agreement to buy the business assets of Format Publishers.
The assets comprise fixed assets, goodwill and inventory.
The parties expect the deal to be completed on February 2, 1997.

McCollam's directors said the gross consideration of approximately NZ$16 million will be satisfied by the issue of 2.54 million McCollam shares at an issue price of NZ$2 per share, the assumption by McCollam of certain financing arrangements valued at $5.66 million and cash payments totalling around $5.2 million.
They said the acquisition will also involve the issue of 530,000 options to members of the Hoare family exercisable at prices from $2-$2.40 per share.
McCollam's will finance the cash elements of the transaction from existing funding lines. The company expects the financial benefits to McCollam's shareholders to be significant.
More details will be released along with McCollams' half year announcement for the 1996/97 financial year, which will be made within the next week.
